widget.label: Bundles Recommendations
widget.description: Displays a set of products that are bundles recommendations purchased

parameter.name: title
parameter.label: Title
parameter.description: Title heading to show over the widget.

parameter.name: sku
parameter.label: Product SKUs
parameter.description: Specify a comma-separated list of SKUs or choose product SKUs from the grid.

parameter.name: cache_lifetime
parameter.label: Cache Lifetime (Seconds)
parameter.description:
Time in seconds between the widget updates.
If not set, equals to 86400 seconds (24 hours). To update widget instantly, go to Cache Management and clear Blocks HTML Output cache.
Widget will not show products that begin to match the specified conditions until cache is refreshed.
